items.text: A linear model would only be able to process sentences shorter than 10 words
Language requires nonlinearity because word meanings change with context. Which of the following best illustrates why a purely linear model would fail at understanding language? (延展题)
A linear model could not capture the fact that the same word can have different meanings in different contexts
A linear model would require 175 billion separate linear equations, one per parameter
A linear model would only work for mathematical functions, not text
